custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a Part Library entry from before this release, entry A, that no part uses ("Total parts" 0).
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu, and click an entry's row: its Part details panel shows Total parts; use one that shows 0.
  • Have a second Part Library entry from before this release, entry B, that a part uses.
    • How to do it: Use an entry whose Part details panel shows Total parts 1 or more, for example 3030 Long Stroke Brake Chamber (W3030LS).
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
